channel.title: Writing.Log
channel.description: Writing on full-stack engineering, LLMs, and building systems.

item.title: Beyond if/else: A First Step Toward System One Decision Models for Robots
item.description: I embedded Laya, an open-source System One decision model, in a Go robot runtime and pitted it against hand-written rules. Here's what worked, what didn't, and why RL on simple tasks plus a sub-2 GB GPU target is the path to something actually useful.

item.title: Building AgentFlow: Bridging Spring Boot and Local LLMs with Context
item.description: A deep dive into building a stateful conversational agent using Spring Boot and local Llama models with custom memory management.

item.title: Agentflow - A Java-Based Memory Layer for LLMs
item.description: Introducing Agentflow, a lightweight prompt grouping and memory layer for Local and Remote Large Language Models.
